name: ERP Procure-to-Pay, GR/IR Clearing & Tariff Cost Engine
description: Reconciles SAP GR/IR clearing imbalances across goods receipts and invoice postings with TCURX scaling, simulates multi-supplier RFx total landed cost under tariff shocks, and rolls up multi-level BOM purchase price variances with cycle detection.

skills.summary: Reconciles SAP WE goods receipts and RE invoice postings with TCURX currency scaling, SHKZG sign flips, and >60d aging classification.
Simulates multi-supplier RFx bids across FOB, freight, tariffs, shock scenarios, payment financing, and quality defect penalties.
Explodes multi-level BOMs with scrap factors, guards against circular BOM graphs, and rolls up leaf PPV drivers.

byo_mcp: SAP S/4HANA / Oracle ERP & PLM BOM MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Extract EKBE PO/GR/IR history tables, multi-level BOM explosions, and supplier RFx bids from BigQuery or customer SAP/Oracle ERP MCP servers (or Drive/SharePoint exports) via remote_cli mcp before running Python cost and clearing engines.

gateway_approval_actions: Posting SAP MR11/F.13 GR/IR clearing entries impacting GL accruals via customer ERP MCP
Awarding supplier RFx purchase orders or updating standard BOM costs in ERP/PLM
python_code_guardrails: Prohibition on clearing IR_WITHOUT_GR lines lacking verified physical goods receipt
BOM cycle detection blocking circular assembly graphs from cost rollups and compound 1/(1-scrap) yield math
TCURX decimal scaling, SHKZG credit reversal handling, and single-source vendor concentration alerts

scheduled_routine.name: daily-grir-aging-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Daily GR/IR Aging Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Execute weekday SAP GR/IR clearing aging check via scripts/gr_ir_reconciler.py to isolate IR_WITHOUT_GR blocks and >60 day accruals.
